The '''Hall of Reflections''' was chamber filled with enhanced mirrors at [[Hologram Fun World]]. The mirrors reflected modified versions of the viewer, with different appearances and personalities. After the place was taken over by [[Borborygmus Gog]], the mirrors produced three-dimensional images.
